source_message.text:
Or is a ticket not being generated at all?

[ACCOUNT_001] It may be fine as is if a 'no code buy' does not generate a ticket (we would only need to adjust some UI notes slightly).
However, if a ticket is generated and sent out randomly but does not show on the dashboard, that will need to be fixed.
[ACCOUNT_001] Any commission sent out randomly also needs to be displayed on the dashboard/attributes.

A no code buy with a $1 tip - 0x8101c6876c85a890325f0515b97426c915f4de5807e64180f4fcb96594acc6cf

(If 'tips' are processed through a second transaction immediately after mint, that explains why the tip did not work, and a UI note will be required for this)
